info.title: Legash Smart Blood Donation & Logistics Network API
info.description: Official Enterprise REST API Specification for Legash Sprint 3. Defines all contracts, schemas, security policies, and workflows for Hospital operations, Donor PIN lifecycle, Emergency logistics, Super Admin oversight, and Scoped Admin RBAC.
